hypotheses.justification: In CQAux.range_ι_comp_eq_univ, finiteness is used only to prove W closed. This is unnecessary: hπW identifies π.base '' W with π.base '' U, which is closed by hUcl and π.isClosedMap. Replace h1 with this argument and remove hWclosed and the Fintype instance. Everything else works for arbitrary groups. Propagate this generalization through exists_mem_translate, iSup_preimage_inf_eq and le_iSup_preimage_imagePreimage; the solution proof then works unchanged. The nonempty image needed for connectedness still follows from hUconn.nonempty.

This follows from [IsFinite π] and hsec. The range of π.base is closed by Scheme.Hom.isClosedMap. Let V be its open complement; then π ⁻¹ᵁ V = ⊥. Sections over ⊥ are subsingleton (Scheme.lean), so hsec V forces Γ(X,V) to be subsingleton. If V were nonempty, Scheme.component_nontrivial would contradict this. Thus V is empty and π.base is surjective. This also handles empty schemes. Derive hsurj locally and retain the original proof.
